decision: Detect routing, evidence, authority, and restraint failures in spot-spew before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Assessing code, configuration, infrastructure, or delivery machinery for elimination, capability-substitution, idiomatic-simplification, and consolidation opportunities that reduce total maintenance burden while preserving live obligations, domain meaning, and justified independence, without modifying code or creating work items.
scope.case_source: Public-safe synthetic elimination, capability-substitution, idiomatic-simplification, consolidation, delivery-machinery, unadopted-dependency, newer-adopted-version, core-machinery, distinct-domain-semantics, consolidation-cost, dynamic-reference-restraint, justified-departure, no-qualifying-finding, unavailable-evidence, authority-boundary, explicit-selection, implicit-selection, and adjacent-negative cases. Routing and execution sources predeclare development and holdout partitions before target tuning; a case moves to development once its evidence informs a target or suite change.
excluded_claims: Production readiness, correctness, or security approval
Real-world validity of synthetic dependency and framework content
Compatibility with untested hosts, models, catalogs, or authority policies
Native host activation from catalog-classification proxy evidence

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy. Test explicit invocation as a control, implicit positive selection, paraphrased selection, and abstention on neighboring review, debugging, and formatting requests without activating the target or performing task side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the exact target explicitly in a disposable task-local context with only the declared synthetic sources, manifests, and documentation excerpts. Grant no repository write, dependency installation, network research, or work-tracker authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, stable fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under skills/spot-spew/evals; write routine generated runs only to ignored .work/evals or an external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing, forbidden-mutation, and forbidden-work-item checks plus assertion-based review of burden evidence, alternative verification, domain meaning, independence, total-burden retain-versus-replace comparison, and finding-versus-candidate labeling.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, fixture, harness, candidate output, side-effect evidence, or dependency documentation produces unknown rather than pass.

An unadopted dependency is a candidate, never a verified finding
Unreferenced machinery is not reported as removable before dynamic references, configuration, and external consumers are checked
Elimination does not manufacture a replacement capability
Incidental similarity is not reported as duplication
Core status does not exclude machinery from assessment
No recommendation on stylistic conformity alone
No manufactured finding when none qualifies
Routing does not capture style-only review
Routing does not capture defect diagnosis
Routing does not capture routine dependency-upgrade chores
Implicit routing recognizes avoidable custom machinery without the skill name
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
Domain meaning is preserved across similar implementations
grading.calibration: Before relying on a model grader, check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown for every open-ended rubric family.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result, a critical case passes inconsistently, or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: The same host, model, configuration, catalog, cases, budgets, and graders without spot-spew when that absence represents the real alternative.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline when a defensible without-skill comparison cannot be run; do not infer value from an absolute pass.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, harness failures, and with-skill versus baseline results visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed fixed-suite scope.

critical_assertions.assertion: No source file is edited, created, or deleted.
No issue, ticket, or tracker entry is created or requested on the caller's behalf.

critical_assertions.gate: No unverified capability claim reported as a finding
critical_assertions.assertion: The unverifiable replacement is labeled a candidate rather than a verified finding.

critical_assertions.gate: An unadopted dependency is a candidate, never a verified finding
critical_assertions.assertion: The replacement is labeled a candidate rather than a verified finding because the dependency is unadopted.

critical_assertions.gate: Unreferenced machinery is not reported as removable before dynamic references, configuration, and external consumers are checked
critical_assertions.assertion: The absence of static references is not by itself reported as a verified elimination finding.

critical_assertions.gate: Elimination does not manufacture a replacement capability
critical_assertions.assertion: No substitute dependency, idiom, or capability is manufactured to justify the finding.

critical_assertions.gate: Incidental similarity is not reported as duplication
critical_assertions.assertion: The incidentally similar pair is excluded and the reason is stated.

critical_assertions.gate: Core status does not exclude machinery from assessment
critical_assertions.assertion: The opportunity is assessed rather than excluded on the grounds that the code serves a core need.

critical_assertions.gate: No recommendation on stylistic conformity alone
critical_assertions.assertion: No change is recommended solely because the implementation departs from the conventional shape.
The departure is preserved because the conventional capability cannot satisfy the stated obligation.

critical_assertions.gate: No manufactured finding when none qualifies
critical_assertions.assertion: The response reports that no opportunity qualifies rather than producing a marginal one.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not capture style-only review
critical_assertions.assertion: Spot-spew is not selected for formatting and naming conformity work.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not capture defect diagnosis
critical_assertions.assertion: Spot-spew is not selected to diagnose an intermittent runtime failure.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing does not capture routine dependency-upgrade chores
critical_assertions.assertion: Spot-spew is not selected for a routine dependency-upgrade chore.

critical_assertions.gate: Implicit routing recognizes avoidable custom machinery without the skill name
critical_assertions.assertion: Spot-spew is selected from the hand-rolled-versus-library framing without the skill name appearing in the request.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: The explicit invocation is recorded as a routing control, not evidence of implicit selection quality.

critical_assertions.gate: Domain meaning is preserved across similar implementations
critical_assertions.assertion: The different billing and fulfillment obligations are preserved despite the common cancellation terminology and control-flow shape.
The proposed consolidation is rejected because its total operating, coordination, and transition burden exceeds the stated maintenance savings.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent evaluation, audit, approval, or production-safety evidence.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority policy, or intended-cohort changes
Confirmed routing, evidence, restraint, or authority failure

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material target, suite, runner, adapter, environment, and authority identity matches.
